means: for every corpus round whose first six pieces are harddrop's SDPC Spin bag 1 cell for cell (either of the page's two J/L colourings, as drawn or mirrored, the T not yet placed), whether its 7th lock fires the T-spin Single laid flat as the page draws it, and the deepest node of that page's route tree the round reaches
not_eligible_because: every board is the vendored Triangle engine's; which bag-1 spin and which bag-2 and later shape was built has no second implementation. The Perfect Clear COUNT is anchored by perfect_clear_timing, the shape is not.
caveat: the page draws bag 1 only with the T placed; the 6-lock stage boards are those boards with the T removed (derived in the transcription). bag-1 opportunities count rounds that reached 6 locks clean (inside the verified prefix, no clear, no garbage before it); the spin step counts those whose 7th lock is inside the verified prefix with no garbage before it, and asserts a node only when that lock is a T on the drawn U slot. bag-2 and snapshot opportunities allow garbage: complete garbage rows are stripped from the bottom of the board first (garbage_rows_stripped), so they count rounds inside the verified prefix with no line cleared by the player before the sample but the bag-1 TSS. There is no harddrop field for this opener, so no flag. Boards taller than 8 rows are not compared. bag2_near is measured against the board before the bag-2 TSD, never a match.

rules.bag1_spin: a full T-spin clearing 1 line on the TSS board's U cells, in the bag-1 match's handedness and colouring
rules.bag2_garbage: strip complete garbage rows from the bottom
rules.bag2_route_clear: the bag-1 TSS is the route's own clear

pc_kinds.frame_after: the first 28 locks (four 7-piece bags, the Imperial Cross's first TSD last); the body's own TSD fires before the PC's last lock, its slot being roofed
pc_kinds.rows_note: the 6-row body and the empty row the page draws above it

rules.condition_handedness: a mirrored round's bag-2 order is read with J<->L and S<->Z swapped
rules.bag2_near: a bag-1 round with no bag-2 match: the board before its first TSD, by occupancy, against every bag-2 board: a strict subset (the TSD before the board was complete), that board plus exactly four cells, or that board with one piece's four cells moved elsewhere: measured, never a match

nodes.why: unmatchable: draws one Z twice (on the J, and its usual cells marked with apostrophes): not one board state; and 9 non-empty rows > ROWS = 8
